);

            case (current_state)

                B: current_state <= C; // Transition from B to C
                C: current_state <= A; // Transition from C to A
                default: current_state <= A; // Default to state A
            endcase
        end
    end

    input [7:0] rate,
    input [7:0] n,
    output reg [15:0] present_value

    reg [23:0] power;       // (1 + rate/100)^n in fixed-point
    reg [31:0] numerator;   // Scaled future_amount for division
    reg [23:0] denominator; // Final denominator after power computation
    integer i;

    always @(*) begin
        // Step 1: Scale rate and compute base value
        scaled_rate = (rate * 256) / 100; // scale rate/100 by 2^8
        base = 256 + scaled_rate;         // 1 + rate/100 scaled by 2^8

        power = 256; // Start with 1 in fixed-point (scaled by 2^8)
        for (i = 0; i < n; i = i + 1) begin

        numerator = future_amount << 8; // Scale future_amount by 2^8
        denominator = power;            // Denominator is the computed power
        present_value = numerator / denominator; // Fixed-point division
    end
endmodule
